meta.title: POS Software in Tanzania
meta.description: SkelApp is the business management platform for Tanzanian retailers. Record sales, purchases, expenses, payment methods, stock and reports across iOS, Android and the web.

hero.title: The point of sale made for
hero.subtitle: Ring up sales in seconds, record every payment however it's made, and keep selling when the power drops — a POS system your team learns in minutes.

affordable.title: Do it all. And then some.
affordable.subtitle: Sales, expenses, purchases, orders — the whole day's money, one record.

cards.title: Every shilling in, every shilling out.
cards.copy: Sales, expenses, purchases and orders — recorded the moment they happen, not at midnight from memory.

cards.title: However they pay, it's on record.

detail.title: What SkelApp can do
detail.subtitle: Sales, branches, inventory, payment tracking, online orders, reports and staff control — one business management platform across iOS, Android and the web.

feature_groups.title: Manage day-to-day operations from one live system.
feature_groups.body: Use SkelApp on iOS, Android and the web to manage sales, purchases, expenses, orders and branch activity from one platform.
feature_groups.items_text:
Multi-device access | Owners, attendants and managers can all work from iOS, Android or the web while staying inside one synced SkelApp account. | assets/card.webp
Multi-location management | Manage multiple branches, shops and warehouses from one system and review sales, expenses, stock and performance by location. | assets/CHECKOUTPOS.png
Sales, purchases, expenses and orders | Record daily transactions in one workflow so nothing has to be rebuilt later from memory. | assets/CASHFLOW.png
Profit and cash flow overview | Open the dashboard and see income, expenses, profit and cash flow clearly before making the next business decision. | assets/DASHBOARD.png
Customer and supplier records | Keep transaction history, balances, customer debts and supplier credits organised in one place. | assets/crm.webp
Payment accounts | Record cash, bank, mobile money, cheque and credit payments against the right sale, purchase or expense, then review them by payment account. | assets/paymentmethod.png

feature_groups.title: Advanced inventory control across your whole business.
feature_groups.body: Maintain accurate stock records with batch-level visibility, transfers, adjustments and location-based availability.
feature_groups.items_text:
Batch tracking | Track stock by batch so you know what came in, what sold first and what needs action next. | assets/hardware.webp
Stock transfers and transfer orders | Move stock between locations with a clear record of what left, what arrived and what is still in transit. | assets/grocery.webp
Stock adjustments and returns | Process corrections, sales returns and purchase returns without losing the audit trail behind each change. | assets/kitchenware.webp
Expiry-date tracking | Monitor items approaching expiry so slow-moving stock does not turn into avoidable loss. | assets/autospare.webp
Low-stock and movement analysis | See low stock, fast movers and slow movers early enough to restock with confidence. | assets/STOCKLIST.png
Stock by location | Check product availability by branch, shop or warehouse from one live view. | assets/Pos System 04.png

feature_groups.title: Online orders, integrations and reports that stay practical.
feature_groups.body: Launch online ordering, connect your accounting and communication tools, and review detailed reports without waiting for manual summaries.
feature_groups.items_text:
Online order management | Launch an online store quickly, receive customer orders digitally and manage order status inside SkelApp. | assets/Mobilehomeview.png
Accounting and communication integrations | Connect Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, bulk SMS providers and WhatsApp to support reporting and customer communication. | assets/quickbooks.png
Advanced business reports | Review profit and loss, cash flow, sales, stock, expenses, purchases, customer debt, supplier credit and payment-account reports from one system. | assets/DASHBOARD.png
Attendants and staff management | Create attendant accounts, assign roles, control access and review performance by user and location. | assets/attendants.webp
Payment method reporting | Break transactions down by payment type and payment account so reconciliation is clearer. | assets/paymentmethod.png
Sales insights by item, customer and location | See what is selling, who is buying, which branch is performing and where to act next. | assets/CASHFLOW.png

features.name: Lightning-fast checkout

offline.title: Keep selling when the power or network drops
offline.subtitle: SkelApp is an offline-first POS. Here's what happens in a blackout:

steps.body: Offline mode switches on by itself the moment power or internet goes down. No button, no panic.
Sales, payment records and receipts keep working right on the device — your queue never notices.
The moment you're back online, every sale, payment record and stock change syncs — nothing lost, nothing typed twice.

features.name: Point of sale
features.body: A fast, friendly till that is easy to learn and keeps selling through power cuts and weak networks. Ring up any sale, record any payment method and print a receipt in seconds — the dependable core every SkelApp device is built around.

features.name: Hardware
features.body: Terminals, registers and tablets that all run the same SkelApp — pick the device that fits your counter today and add more as you grow. Reliable, locally supported and ready to sell straight out of the box.

features.name: Integration
features.body: Connect the tools you already use — mobile money, cards, bank settlement and accounting — so payments and records flow into one place automatically, with no double entry at the end of the day.

features.name: Features
features.body: Inventory, customers and reports all work together in one app. Track stock across branches, keep your regulars coming back and see exactly where your business stands every single morning.

pricing.title: Run your whole shop for
pricing.note: Karibu sifuri kwa siku — about 500 TZS a day runs your entire shop, less than a cup of chai.

items.a: SkelApp is a point of sale system built for small businesses in Tanzania. It runs on your phone, a tablet, or the Skel Register, and handles checkout, payments, stock, madeni and daily reports in one app.
Yes — SkelApp is an offline-first POS. When power or network drops, you keep selling on the device, and everything syncs the moment you're back online.
Cash, mobile money, bank transfers and cards — record every payment however your customers pay, with payment accounts keeping each method reconciled.

items.q: Do I need to buy hardware?
items.a: No. SkelApp starts on the phone already in your pocket. Add a receipt printer or the Skel Register whenever your counter is ready for one.
TZS 15,000 per month — about 500 shillings a day — or TZS 150,000 per year with two months free. Every feature included, no tiers.

items.q: Can I run more than one shop?
items.a: Yes. Every branch and staff account is included — you see every location's sales, stock and staff activity from one dashboard, and you can transfer stock between locations.

items.q: Which devices does SkelApp run on?
items.a: iOS, Android and any web browser — phone, tablet, computer or the Skel Register, all synced to the same account.

items.q: Does SkelApp work with accounting software?
items.a: Yes — SkelApp integrates with Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero and Sage, plus bulk SMS providers and WhatsApp for receipts and customer messages.
